name: Cleantap Energy
old_description: Cleantap Energy, LLC is an energetic Maine based solar project development company with a team bringing decades of experience.
about:
Based in Gray, Maine, Cleantap Energy, LLC operates as a solar project development and installation company. The firm describes itself as a Maine-based team with decades of combined experience in the solar industry.

The company designs and installs custom photovoltaic systems for residential and commercial customers, including retrofit solutions for existing properties. Its services span site evaluation, system design, permitting, installation, and assistance with incentive paperwork such as the 30% federal tax credit and USDA REAP grants. According to its website, the team has completed 84 renewable energy projects, assisted 62 businesses with renewable transitions, and maintains 16 installation crews.

Cleantap Energy serves homeowners throughout Maine seeking to reduce electricity costs, as well as businesses ranging from small commercial operations to larger facilities that can leverage accelerated depreciation and grant programs. The company also works with agricultural clients, noting that systems can be built on existing farms or ranches.

The firm emphasizes a transparent, customer-focused approach, promising to remove the guesswork from solar adoption. It highlights its local presence, warranty responsiveness—such as replacing a faulty panel within days—and a commitment to sustainability as key differentiators.
